name: Dark Power grants Stamina equal to Agility (#713)
contract: Dark Power 681340 (installed Spell.dbc, client set of 2026-09-17) is a passive family-21 spell with one effect: SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_STAT_FROM_STAT (327), misc 2 (Stamina) MiscValueB 1 (Agility), base 99 die 1 -> 100%. Its Description reads 'You now gain 2 Stamina for every 2 Agility', i.e. one for one, which is what 100% means (older client sets carried 50% and a 1-for-2 text). GetAscensionStatFromStatBonus adds CalculatePct(source stat, amount) to the destination stat and UpdateStats refreshes it when Agility moves. Base stats are not assumed: the Stamina gained by learning is snapshotted and Agility, read with the same stat metric, must equal it within 2 points (the talent does not change Agility); then Increased Agility 40 (14404, +40 Agility) must add 40 Stamina (39-41).
